description: Kernel unit suite: ordered outcomes, thrown errors, safe structured metadata, controllable timing, recommendations dedup/order, fail/warn/pass including empty/all-skip, early stop and projections.

Run shared/services/email/providers/__tests__/MicrosoftGraphAdapter.diagnostics.test.ts and normalized before/after report fixtures for healthy, missing-token, Graph failure, both identifier options and live subscription cleanup; preserve key omission and recommendation text/order.

Run server/src/test/unit/lib/teams/actions/teamsDiagnosticsActions.test.ts and packages/integrations/src/components/settings/integrations/TeamsIntegrationSettings.diagnostics.test.tsx; compare normalized legacy reports including thrown errors and completion-time createdAt.

Graph error matrix: HTTP/header IDs, already-sanitized failure and EmailProviderError metadata survive outbound; inbound legacy mapping remains stable and outbound never inherits Mail.Read/folder consent advice.

DB-backed integration happy path against migrated schema: saved enabled provider/binding resolves for session tenant using real queries; report default/ticketing/effective From and selected dispatch correctly.

DB-backed guard suite: missing settings, disabled provider and foreign-tenant binding cannot initialize/send; unauthorized and client-portal callers fail before reads/network, and no caller-supplied tenant is trusted.

Microsoft matrix: missing credentials, refresh failure/token replacement, valid self scopes, delegated missing Mail.Send.Shared, missing Mail.Send, opaque/malformed/missing-scp token and unknown /me identity produce accurate outcomes without duplicate identity requests.

Permission evidence matrix: explicit ErrorSendAsDenied on live send names Exchange permission with status/request-id; generic 403 remains inconclusive; draft success and readable Sent Items never imply Send As or writable Sent Items; no additional OAuth scopes.

Manual empirical gate in authorized real Microsoft tenant: compare same-token/route draft and send outcomes across documented grant/scope matrix; record redacted evidence and retain advisory if unavailable or unreliable. If draft experiment runs, verify cleanup of only its own ID including delete failure. Mocks cannot satisfy the authoritative gate.

SMTP representative transport suite: successful verify with evidence, connection refusal, TLS certificate/handshake failure, AUTH 535 and unknown-phase error preserve native code/responseCode/command, truthful skips and no credentials; one verification attempt and no invented stage timings.
Resend tests: actual domains success, restricted-key denial, network failure and cached verification preserve evidence/freshness without claiming domains permission proves send permission.

Live-send matrix across providers: default and invalid-recipient paths send zero messages; opted-in valid recipient uses effective production sender/provider once; Graph accepted versus delivered and uncertain outcome are represented without diagnostic resend.

Shared-dialog component and CE/EE entry tests: saved configuration notice, both entry points, unknown/warn/fail rows, identities, protocol IDs, live-send opt-in, validation, pending/error/retry and bundle export.

Nested redaction tests with seeded OAuth/SMTP/Resend secrets, Axios config, body, paths and recommendation identifiers: no secret appears in action report or export; default export redacts identifiers while status/request IDs survive; includeIdentifiers never enables secrets.
Notification logger test: EmailProviderError emits explicit errorCode/status/requestId; ordinary/non-Error throws remain safe; disabled-service path and original rethrow semantics are unchanged.

Compile relevant shared/email/integrations and CE/EE consumers, run existing Teams related regression suites, and search both runStep declaration forms/status folds to verify all three consumers use one kernel.

Manual UI smoke on CE and hosted EE outbound tabs: keyboard operation, light/dark status readability, saved provider selection, inconclusive advice, optional controlled live send and redacted copied/downloaded support bundle.
